items.point: Hong Kong’s Faster Payment System (FPS) will be temporarily unavailable for 10 hours on 29 November 2026 from 1am to 11am due to a planned system enhancement.
items.so_what: Critical core-banking and payment services reliant on FPS must schedule system maintenance during this window and proactively notify digital banking clients.
items.title: Faster Payment System to Go Offline for 10 Hours on 29 November

items.point: Ping An Digital Bank received an additional HK$500 million capital injection from its parent company Lufax Holding to expand its capital base and support growth.
items.so_what: Competitor virtual banks are receiving balance sheet backing from parent institutions, intensifying capital competition in Hong Kong's digital banking space.

zh: 轉數快於11月29日暫停服務10小時
香港銀行同業結算將進行系統提升
金管局要求銀行提前通知客戶作安排
work.en: Hong Kong's Faster Payment System (FPS) will be offline for 10 hours on Sunday, 29 November 2026, from 1:00 am to 11:00 am for a planned system enhancement. Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited will perform the maintenance work. The HKMA has instructed banks and SVF operators to notify customers in advance to make alternative payment arrangements.
work.title: Faster Payment System to Go Offline for 10 Hours on 29 November

zh: 平安壹賬通銀行獲陸金所注入5億港元
資金將用於擴充資本金及支持業務增長
進一步強化其作為平安集團金融平台角色
work.en: Ping An Digital Bank has received an additional HK$500 million capital injection from its parent company, Lufax Holding. The bank stated that the funding will bolster its capital base and drive further business expansion. It also strengthens the bank's strategic role within Ping An Group's broader integrated financial platform.
work.title: Ping An Digital Bank Gets Further HK$500 Million Funding from Parent Firm

zh: 螞蟻銀行推出「螞不上息」理財新功能
用戶於贖回基金或賣股期間仍可賺息
旨在提升投資者於交易轉接期之資金收益
work.en: Ant Bank Hong Kong has unveiled a new feature called "Ant Savings Interest" allowing users to continue earning interest on their funds even while redeeming mutual funds or selling stocks. The tool aims to eliminate zero-yield transition periods during investment cash-outs.
work.title: 螞蟻銀行推「螞上有息」功能 贖回基金或賣股期間有息收

zh: 大華銀行與廣州市政府簽署合作備忘錄
擬於廣州設立全新科技創新中心
將運用當地人才研發及擴展全行金融方案
work.en: UOB has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Guangzhou Municipal Government to establish a proposed technology innovation centre in Guangzhou. The bank plans to leverage the local tech ecosystem and talent pool to develop and scale banking solutions across the group.
work.title: UOB to Establish Technology Innovation Centre in Guangzhou

zh: 按揭證券公司與亞投行簽署合作意向書

work.en: The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation (HKMC) and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) have signed a letter of intent establishing a cooperation framework. The joint initiative aims to mobilize private capital into infrastructure projects across the region.

zh: 調查指本港富裕投資者退休目標升至119萬美元
投資者平均僅達成目標進度的45%
近八成受訪者預期將以彈性方式逐步退休
work.en: A wealth report by HSBC reveals that Hong Kong affluent investors have raised their average retirement savings target by 7% to US$1.19 million, but have currently achieved only 45% of that goal. Furthermore, 77% plan to transition into retirement gradually or flexibly rather than stopping work outright.
work.title: 調查：本港富裕投資者退休儲蓄目標升至119萬美元

zh: 機構券商Marex推出國際支付平台

work.en: Institutional broker Marex has launched an international payments platform following authorization from the UK Financial Conduct Authority. The service supports over 150 currencies, offering settlement in both fiat and digital currencies including stablecoins.
work.title: Marex launches international payments platform, including stablecoins

zh: 滙豐投管對明年內地及港股維持審慎樂觀
料明年首季港股市場將維持區間波動
看好AI應用國產化及高派息金融股
work.en: HSBC Asset Management maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook on Mainland and Hong Kong equities for next year, citing attractive valuations and improving shareholder returns. However, it expects the market to remain range-bound in Q1 due to a soft consumption recovery and a high earnings base for select sectors.
work.title: 滙豐投資管理：對明年內地及港股維持審慎樂觀態度
